title: Orbit independent check result
description: Final JSON object returned by an independent check or adjudication run (Orbit 1, contracts/task-runtime.md). Strings are expected to be non-empty and next_check_seconds is a positive integer, even where JSON Schema alone cannot express it inside Codex structured output. delivery is the checker's structured delivery-readiness judgment, separate from verdict and findings: ready=true requires the actual deliverable to be inspectable at check time (the fixed artifact, or the Root's actually delivered final answer visible in the program record), never a Root claim or a verdict alone.
